faq.q: Who is Jason Duval in GTA 6?
faq.a: Jason Duval is one of the two central playable characters in Grand Theft Auto VI. He grew up around grifters and crooks, later served in the Army, and settled in the Leonida Keys working for local drug runners.

faq.q: How does Jason Duval meet Lucia Caminos?
faq.a: Rockstar's official material does not detail the meeting itself. It says his circumstances change after meeting Lucia, and their relationship forms the center of the game's published story premise.

faq.q: Where does Jason Duval live in GTA 6?
faq.a: He lives rent-free in the Leonida Keys at a property owned by Brian Heder, in exchange for helping Brian with local shakedowns.

faq.q: Did Jason Duval serve in the military?
faq.a: Yes. Rockstar says he spent time in the Army while trying to leave his troubled teenage years behind, before settling in the Keys.

faq.q: Can Jason Duval be played from the start of GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The official material confirms he is one of the two central characters but does not specify when he becomes playable or how the story structures his introduction.
